core_obligations: Test against an open neighbourhood: for a point of the image of the open subset and any open neighbourhood of it, find a point of the complement of the image of the complementary closed set inside that neighbourhood (proof lines 5456-5460)

Produce the witness: the intersection of the open subset with the preimage of the neighbourhood is nonempty open, so its image of the complement is not everything, and a point outside that image lies both in the neighbourhood and in the required complement (proof lines 5460-5462)
proof_roadmap: 取 y ∈ f(U) 与 y 的任一开邻域 V；要证 V 与 Y ∖ f(X ∖ U) 相交。
W = U ∩ f^{-1}(V) 非空开 ⇒ f(X ∖ W) ≠ Y；取 y' ∉ f(X ∖ W)。
初等地可验 y' ∈ V 且 y' ∈ Y ∖ f(X ∖ U)。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives a technical containment describing the image of an open subset under a surjective map which never maps a proper closed subset onto the whole space (author lemma at source lines 5448-5454, label lemma-image-open-technical). The proof (source lines 5456-5463) argues through an arbitrary open neighbourhood of a point of the image, uses the hypothesis on the complement of a suitable open subset to find a witness and verifies that the witness lies in the required complement (proof lines 5456-5462). The construction of the witness is the content. H2.
